a.lede: Hugging Face executive Irene Solaiman warns that growing cyberattacks on open AI platforms could force tighter security restrictions, threatening the accessibility that makes open-source communities valuable to developers worldwide.
a.title: Cyberattacks threaten to make open-source AI a little less open, Hugging Face exec warns

b.lede: Meanwhile, a group of nonprofits sue AI giants and cite AI-driven cyberattacks
b.title: OpenAI launches security products, tells orgs they’re doomed if they don’t use them
